summary: iQSTEL Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an Equity Purchase Agreement and Registration Rights Agreement with M2B Funding Corp. The agreement allows the company to sell up to $50 million of common stock at 94% of the lowest VWAP in the six days after a put notice, subject to volume caps and a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation. The company issued $1 million in commitment shares. This is a structured equity line (ELOC), not a transformative special situation. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No special-situation category applies; this is a routine capital-raising facility.
